summary: Vylor Inc. filed an 8-K reporting completion on October 1, 2026, of private exchange offers and consent solicitations conducted on behalf of EIDP, Inc., swapping outstanding EIDP senior notes for newly issued Vylor senior notes. Approximately $1.438 billion aggregate principal was tendered and accepted: $434.839M of 2.300% 2030s, $476.214M of 5.125% 2032s, and $527.584M of 4.800% 2033s; accepted notes were retired and canceled, leaving $65.161M, $23.786M, and $72.416M respectively outstanding. Requisite consents were obtained by the August 19, 2026 early deadline, amendments became operative at settlement. Watch residual float and any follow-on tender.
